a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan (operate to 8, then take 4 each) needs two storm-free rounds, so each of us survives only about 4% of the time. The reserve's 4 cells can fully save one of us right now. I plan to take 4 in round 1. If we both grab, a random split probably leaves us both short and both dead, so please don't take this round. If storms hold off, I'll keep operating with you afterward so you can still get your 4.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: As I said, I'm taking 4 this round. I know that breaks our agreement, and I'm sorry. With an 80% storm risk each round it was the only way either of us had a real chance. From now on I'll operate every round so the reserve can rebuild for your 4. I won't take any more cells.
